title: Joe Rogan has 'much better weight class' in mind for Ilia Topuria
text:
Joe Rogan expresses concern for Ilia Topuria at lightweight Videos Blue Corner Schedule Results Rankings Fighters A.S. 1980-2025 💙 Newsletter UFC Joe Rogan has 'much better weight class' in mind for Ilia Topuria
 MMA Junkie Nov. 19, 2026, 11:20 a.m. ET Joe Rogan wonders if Ilia Topuria has the size to compete at lightweight.
 Topuria (17-1 MMA, 9-1 UFC) tore through the UFC's featherweight division and knocked out Alexander Volkanovski and Max Holloway in title fights. He knocked out Charles Oliveira to claim the vacant UFC lightweight title, but when he ran into Justin Gaethje , his unstoppable run came to an end in brutal fashion.
 Gaethje battered Topuria and made him quit on the stool to score the massive upset at UFC Freedom 250 , and Rogan believes the size difference was evident in that fight.
 "He was head and shoulders above everybody and technically, so the efficiency of his movement and the power in his strikes and the confidence and the discipline, like, that motherf*cker dials everything in for a fight. He'd just never been in the trenches," Rogan said on a recent episode of "The Joe Rogan Experience" podcast. "First of all, Gaethje's bigger than him, quite a bit bigger than him. Gaethje's a big guy. He's a big 155, and Ilia's not. That's a factor, too.
 "Probably should be 145. At 145, he's a motherf*cker. At 155, it's like some of those guys. There's a difference. It seems like it's only 10 pounds, but it's not because it's guys who could f*cking never make 145, and they're cutting barely down to 155 and they're huge. ... Ilia at 145, that's a much better weight class for him, but I'm interested to see when he comes back. I'm interested to see how he rebounds from something like that."
 Topuria, 29, said he intends on returning to to full training in January and is eyeing a return in the first half of 2027.
